name: Prefab vs Custom Garage Additions

mainEntity.name: Are prefab garage additions worth it in Los Angeles County compared with custom-built garages?
mainEntity.text: Are prefab garage additions worth it in Los Angeles County compared with custom-built garages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prefab garages can look attractive because the structure itself may go up quickly, but the total project cost depends on much more than the shell. In Los Angeles County, homeowners still need to account for permit review, foundation work, grading, utility connections, and any site-specific requirements. Prefab options may work well on simpler lots with straightforward access and limited design needs. Custom-built garages are often better for tight properties, sloped sites, matching an existing home, or future ADU planning. The right choice depends on how much flexibility the homeowner needs and how much coordination the site requires. A contractor should explain whether a prefab product really reduces cost after all site and code items are included. For many projects, the cheapest-looking option on paper is not the cheapest finished garage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefab garages can be faster to install, but they are not always cheaper once foundations, permits, utility work, and site prep are included. Custom-built garages usually offer better fit, finish, and design flexibility for difficult lots or strict local requirements.
